what_to_do.en: Tap the word that fits the blank.

stages.choice_rule: Four different real sight words from the roots list, in standard spelling. Exactly one word replaces the lowercase token blank and makes the sentence grammatical. Put that word at answer_index. The other three are whole words that do not fit. Never use a misspelling. Tier 1 choices are obviously wrong. Tier 2 choices share a first letter or a near meaning. Tier 3 choices are near misses in spelling or tense.

gold_items.stem: He got wet blank of the rain.
They blank a big cake today.
The kids blank home after school.
blank new books are on the little desk.
<NAME> blank a long letter to a friend.

roots: Every wrong choice is one real whole word in standard spelling. Never use a misspelling from the word list.
A wrong choice must not complete the sentence. Do not offer a second word that also fits.
Tier 1 wrong choices are sight words that cannot fit the sentence at all.
Tier 2 wrong choices are real sight words that share a first letter or a close meaning but still do not fit.
Tier 3 wrong choices are near misses such as their and there, write and right, or the present form beside the past form.
Keep every choice inside the kid world of school, home, food, pets, play, family, and weather. No brands and no real names.

tier_rules.1: Stems of four or five words. The right word is a common sight word. Wrong choices are real sight words that do not fit the sentence at all.
tier_rules.2: Stems of five to seven words about home, school, play, or weather. Wrong choices are other sight words that start the same or almost fit, but only one word works.
tier_rules.3: Stems of seven to ten words. Wrong choices are near misses such as their and there or write and wrote. Only one choice is grammatical.

fits_sentence.en: Read every word. Only one sight word makes the sentence make sense.
fits_sentence.ko: 각 단어를 읽어 보세요. 문장을 자연스럽게 만드는 기본 단어는 하나뿐입니다.

because_why.en: Because tells why, so it joins the reason to the sentence.
because_why.ko: because는 이유를 말해 주며 두 부분을 이어 줍니다.

past_sight.en: This already happened, so the past sight word is the one that fits.
past_sight.ko: 이미 일어난 일이므로 과거 기본 단어가 알맞습니다.

their_owner.en: Their shows who owns something, as in their books.
their_owner.ko: their는 누구의 것인지 나타냅니다. their books처럼 쓰입니다.
